streamId.description: quote linking ID for requestor to pass back to link quotes for analytics purposes

quotes.description: A collection of responses matching the request

quoteId.description: unique quote identifier. Strongly unique for non-indicative. For indicative, only unique across multiple quotes within a single REST response.

rate.description: quote rate, set to null if no quote was found for currency pair. This is the outright rate when a forward, or near leg of a swap.

requestedBasisRate.description: Returns rate expressed as Source Currency as the Base Currency

cardedRate.description: contains the base rate the customer would have got if mapped to the base customer group, set to null if no quote was found for currency pair

equivalentAudRate.description: equivalent rate at AUD, of dealt currency, quoted in market convention (standard basis). E.g Only AUD/CAD 0.72 and NEVER CAD/AUD 1.37

expiryTime.description: contains the time at which this quote expires

rfqExpirySeconds.description: Contains the number of seconds left that this RFQ is valid for. Only supplied in Markets RFQ quote responses

indicative.description: indicates whether this quote is acceptable or not

msg.description: error message when quote is not available for requested currency pair

valid.description: indicates whether quote is valid or invalid

correlationId.description: indicates the correlation Id associated to quote

dealerCode.description: If Eager booking is required then Dealer Code would be provided which will be used to book the trade on accept quote

fwdPts.description: Used for forwards and swap near leg only

spotRate.description: Used for forwards and swap near leg only

swapPts.description: Used for swaps, pre-deliveries, and extensions. Has the swap points of a swap, and adjusted swap points of a Predelivery and extension

contractType.description: Identifies between a spot, forward, or swap quote. Valid descriptions are SPOT, FWD, SWAP, PRE_DELIVERY, EXTENSION, EXTENSION_UPTO_SPOT

reasonCode.description: Provides a computer friendly error code for when the quote is returned as invalid, or is in dealer intervention.

counterFundingAmount.description: Used for pre-deliveries, and extensions. Has the funding amount in counter currency of a Predelivery and extension

isOutOfTheMoney.description: Used for pre-deliveries, and extensions. Indicates if the customer is out of the money while performing a Predelivery and extension

counterCcy.description: Used for pre-deliveries, and extensions. Three letter code of currency in which the counterFundingAmount is mentioned

fxQuote.description: A collection of responses matching the request

fxQuoteLeg.description: Used for swaps only. Has the details of the far leg of a swap
